title: Final Answer (1)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct minimum energy E_0 = 2.225 GeV for reaction (1) when the target dissociates into a proton and 4 pions.

title: Final Answer (2)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct minimum energy E_0 = 2.225 GeV for reaction (1) when the projectile dissociates into a proton and 4 pions.

title: Final Answer (3)
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct minimum energy E_0 = 3.847 GeV for reaction (2) when both protons dissociate into a proton and 4 pions.

title: Correct Use of Invariants
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the invariant mass condition E^2 - p^2 = m^2 in their calculations.

title: Energy-Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student must demonstrate an understanding of energy and momentum conservation in the context of the reactions.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common sign mistakes in the energy-momentum equations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should be cautious of missing factors in the equations derived from the invariant mass condition.
